name: CT scanning
summary: Our Radiology department is on the ground floor. A CT aortogram starts at ₱25,000.

name: Sleep studies
summary: An overnight study in our Heart & Lung Unit for snoring, daytime tiredness and suspected sleep apnoea. Diagnostic, CPAP and split-night studies, from ₱25,500.

name: X-ray
summary: Chest, bone and abdominal radiography, on the ground floor.

name: Laparoscopic gallbladder surgery
summary: The gallbladder removed through small incisions instead of one large cut — less pain, smaller scars and a shorter stay. From ₱65,000, net of PhilHealth, including a private room for three days, operating room, anaesthesia, supplies and medicines.

name: General surgery
summary: Hernia repair, appendectomy and minor procedures.

name: Maternity
summary: Packages with our OB-Gyn team, net of PhilHealth. Newborn charges are separate.
priceNote: Each package covers the doctor's professional fee, operating room, facilities, supplies and medicines. Applies to non-emergency, uncomplicated cases; terms and conditions apply.

name: Emergency Room
summary: We receive urgent and emergency cases, including on holidays. Under the Anti-Hospital Deposit Law we cannot require a deposit before giving basic emergency care.

name: Telemedicine
summary: An online consultation with one of our doctors, and our own video series Doctor in the House.
